# Choosing columns without naming them

When a table has thirty columns and you want the eight beginning with `q`,
naming them is tedious and goes stale the moment a ninth arrives.

Three chapters, each a different question about a column. What is its name
shaped like? What kind of thing does it hold? And once you have chosen a set of
them, how do you apply one calculation to all of them at once?

This is the part that replaces a family of helper functions in other tools with
one word and a written subject.
